findings.evidence: `Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Basic.lean:334` `def C : R →+* MvPowerSeries σ R` under `section Semiring`/`variable [Semiring R]`; `:347` `coeff_C n a = if n = 0 then a else 0`; `:786` `theorem c_eq_algebraMap : C = algebraMap R (MvPowerSeries σ R) := rfl`. The two duplicated proofs are RestrictedPowerSeries.lean:178-181 and 359-363, differing only in the simp set (`coeff_one` vs `algebraMap_apply, coeff_C`).
findings.fix: Prove `isRestricted_C {k} {A} [Semiring A] [TopologicalSpace A] (a : A) : IsRestricted (MvPowerSeries.C a : MvPowerSeries (Fin k) A)` with the existing proof body (using `MvPowerSeries.coeff_C`), then derive both: `isRestricted_one` from `map_one MvPowerSeries.C ▸ isRestricted_C 1`, and `isRestricted_algebraMap` from `MvPowerSeries.c_eq_algebraMap ▸ isRestricted_C a`. Update the module docstring line 99 accordingly.
findings.issue: `isRestricted_one` (L176-181) and `isRestricted_algebraMap` (L356-363) are the same four-line `isRestricted_of_hasFiniteSupport <| (Set.finite_singleton 0).subset …` argument written twice, both special cases of "a constant series is restricted". The general form `IsRestricted (MvPowerSeries.C a)` holds at `[Semiring A] [TopologicalSpace A]`, so a user with the noncommutative `[Ring A]` that `restrictedMvPowerSeriesSubring` is stated at can exhibit only `0` and `1` as constants in `A⟨T₁, …, Tₖ⟩`; `isRestricted_algebraMap` is gated behind `CommSemiring` purely by the `Algebra` instance, not by the mathematics.

summary: Binder generality is right everywhere the PR touched (AddMonoid/AddGroup/Module are each the weakest class at which the MvPowerSeries operation exists, and the submodule correctly drops NonarchimedeanRing), but the constant-series fact is proved twice as special cases instead of once in general: `isRestricted_one` and `isRestricted_algebraMap` repeat the same finite-support argument and leave `C a` unavailable over a noncommutative semiring.
